debug.description: Turn on debugging output to console

user.description: User to drop privileges to (e.g., saned, daemon, root)

group.description: Group to be used for scanner access (e.g., lp, scanner, daemon)

sane_config_dir.description: Path to the SANE configuration directory passed as env var to saned

scriptdir.description: Directory where scanbd looks for action scripts

timeout.description: Poll timeout in milliseconds for checking devices

action_script.description: Default action script name relative to scriptdir
